title.narrative: Strengthening Primary Health Care and Surveillance in Haiti

description.narrative: The PDO of the proposed Project is to: (i) increase utilization of primary health care services in selected geographical areas; (ii) strengthen surveillance capacity especially for cholera, and (iii) provide an immediate and effective response to an eligible crisis or emergency.

Schedule 2 Section IV.1: No later than one month before the beginning of each FY, the Recipient shall prepare and furnish an AWPfor that FY, satisfactory to the WB, including the activities to be carried under the Project during said FY with their respectivesources of funding. Schedule 2 Section IV.2: No later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall develop and furnish to theWorld Bank (WB) the Community Health Strategy and Implementation Plan referred to in Part 1(b) of the Project, all in a manneracceptable to the WB.

Schedule 2. Section I. B. 2. Project Operational Manual. Without limitation upon the foregoing, the Recipient, shall: (i) no laterthan one (1) month after each calendar semester (starting with the calendar semester immediately after the calendar semester inwhich the Effective Date falls) and according to the provisions of the Project Operational Manual, prepare and furnish to theAssociation, for its review, an evaluation of the Results-Based Payments and recommendations of any adjustment required to be madeto the Results-Based Payments to ensure that they continue to comply with the criteria set forth in Section I.C of this Schedule;(ii) afford the Association a reasonable opportunity to exchange views with the Recipient on each said evaluation andrecommendation; and (iii) adopt and apply such adjusted Results-Based Payments, as shall have been approved by the Association, toResults-Based Payments Agreements awarded after said date.

Schedule 2. Section II. Project Monitoring, Reporting and Evaluation. The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each ProjectReport not later than one (1) month after the end of each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.

Schedule 2. Section IV. Other Undertakings. No later than one (1) month before the beginning of each fiscal year, the Recipientshall prepare and furnish an annual work plan (Annual Work Plan) for that fiscal year, satisfactory to the Association, includingthe activities to be carried under the Project during said fiscal year. Said Annual Work Plan may be modified from time to timeduring the fiscal year, with prior approval of the Association.

title.narrative: Percentage of notified maternal deaths investigated per year

comment.narrative: Difficulty accessing health facilities and growing displaced population hinder the surveillance unit's capacity to investigate maternal deaths. As of January 31, 2025, only 60% of maternal deaths have been investigated at the institutional level.

title.narrative: Percentage of notified maternal deaths investigated per year

comment.narrative: Despite the difficult socio-political context, corrective measures have been put in place to strengthen the investigation of maternal deaths. Notification of maternal death remains insufficient and exacerbated by the constraints of the complex context. Data represents percent of maternal deaths investigated 100 out of maternal deaths reported 125 at the institutional level, between October 2023 March 2024.

title.narrative: Number of health facilities rehabilitated or reconstructed

comment.narrative: Civil works are constrained by prevailing insecurity affecting supply chains and supervision. Three health facility rehabilitations ( Arniquet, Ducis, St Louis du Nord) which were expected to be completed by December 2023 are now planned to be finalized by 30 September 2024. Ten additional health facilities are also expected to be competed by 31st December 2024.

title.narrative: Number of health facilities rehabilitated or reconstructed

comment.narrative: Civil works are expected to accelerate during 2025 as procurement processes are completed.

title.narrative: Number of peripheral storage warehouses upgraded based on identified need and in accordance with minimum national standards on storage of medical products

comment.narrative: Although the standardized design of the warehouses was finalized and validated by the MSPP, there has been a significant increase in cost (more than double). This indicator is expected to be met once the MSPP identifies a solution that responds to the needs on the ground, is reasonable in cost, and can be completed with the project's timeframe.

title.narrative: Number of Community Health Workers who were trained based on the new Community Health Strategy

comment.narrative: Training of trainers of community health workers was completed in Grand-Anse and Artibonite by December 31st, 2023 (205 ASCP trained). Remaining training activities have been on hold as they depend on global fund Co financing (now available after project restructuring). Training activities can and will resume. The target of 500 is expected to be met in the next 12 months.
